articles.summary: Most medical canvasses are quoted between $150 and $400 flat, and almost no vendor publishes rates (Superunit does: from $1.50 per location). What's in that price, what drives it up, how canvassing compares to records retrieval, surveillance, and IMEs on cost per case, and the turnaround cost nobody quotes.
articles.title: How Much Does Medical Canvassing Cost? Pricing, Turnaround, and What Drives Both

articles.summary: Three copy-paste employment verification letter templates — a standard third-party letter, a proof of income letter for landlords, and a lender-ready VOE built around Fannie Mae Form 1005 — plus the fields every letter needs and the two errors that invalidate most letters.
articles.title: Employment Verification Letter: 3 Free Templates and What to Include

articles.summary: Payroll database tools verify most applicants instantly, but 30–40% have no connectable payroll record — thousands of manual employer calls at enterprise volume. This guide shows how AI employer outreach closes that gap without adding headcount, and where Snappt and Payscore still fit.
articles.title: Employment Verification at Scale: A Guide for Enterprise Property Managers

articles.summary: An offer letter is the hardest income document to verify because nothing sits behind it — no payroll run, no IRS record, just a job that hasn't started. This guide covers the red flags that filter fake offers fast and the framework for confirming one directly with the employer who supposedly wrote it.
articles.title: Offer Letter Fraud: How to Spot Fake Offers and Verify Them Fast

articles.summary: A DOT-compliant background check has five components: the §391.23 three-year employment history, MVR, Clearinghouse query, PSP report, and criminal checks where required. We rank six vendors, from full-suite platforms like Checkr to Superunit for direct previous-employer verification.
articles.title: Best DOT Background Check Companies, Ranked by Compliance Coverage (2026)

articles.summary: Truv is fast and cheap for payroll-connected borrowers, but its consumer-permissioned model stalls with no direct-outreach fallback. This guide ranks the six best Truv alternatives — Superunit, Argyle, Pinwheel, Payscore, Truework, and InformData — across coverage model, turnaround, FCRA readiness, and fit.
articles.title: Best Truv Alternatives for Employment Verification (2026)

articles.summary: Human canvassing throughput is capped by headcount and business hours. Scaling means solving three bottlenecks — facility scoping, simultaneous outreach, and documentation consistency — which AI parallel outreach removes without adding staff, while humans still win on access, escalation, and MSA-restricted files.
articles.title: How to Scale Medical Canvassing Without Adding SIU Headcount

articles.summary: Superunit, Xref, Refapp, Harver/Checkster, Checkr, and Discovered.ai compared on channels, turnaround, completion rate, customization, and pricing. Multi-channel AI outreach hits ~80% completion in ~3 hours for under $5 a reference — and when a survey platform or a screening bundle fits better.
articles.title: Reference Check Automation: Superunit vs. Discovered.ai vs. Checkr vs. Xref

articles.summary: Pharmacy canvassing confirms whether and when a claimant filled prescriptions at a pharmacy — no medication names, no PHI, no signed release. This guide covers what it surfaces, the HIPAA boundaries, the fraud patterns it exposes, and how Superunit runs it on a 24-hour turnaround.
articles.title: Pharmacy Canvassing for Insurance Fraud Investigation
